_meta.anthropic/searchHint: css layout style box model overflow computed position covered audit

description: With a ref or selector: the element's box model, position, computed CSS (or the properties you name), flex/grid layout, visibility, text contrast, overflow, and what is covering it. With no target: a layout audit of the whole page — horizontal overflow and its culprits, clipped text, broken images, missing alt text, small tap targets, low-contrast text, layout shift, fonts. Numbers instead of a screenshot, for CSS debugging.

ref.description: Element ref from browser_find or browser_capabilities.

selector.description: CSS selector, if you have no ref.

name: browser_inspect
title: Inspect layout and CSS
